name: Diurnal-Stele
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by tectonic rift valleys. Beyond an orbital debris ring, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Ambush predators lie beneath the thermally warm silt, patient as geology.
Approach protocols for the smuggler cache are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
Business at the outpost is steady and deniable. Newcomers are welcome, watched, and priced accordingly.
